sloka: बह्वीः च विविध आकारा रूप यौवन गर्विताः ।स्त्रियः सुग्रीव भवने ददर्श स महाबलः ॥४-३३-२२॥
transliteration: bahvīḥ ca vividha ākārā rūpa yauvana garvitāḥ ।striyaḥ sugrīva bhavane dadarśa sa mahābalaḥ ॥4-33-22॥

translations.english: Powerful Lakshmana saw many females of different forms proud of their youth and charm at the palace of Sugriva.
